experiment_template.research_question: Does exact-generation event-derived state improve native evidence selection after real recycling without speculative tokenizer work?
stop_conditions: Any projection measurement lacks a matching selected render generation.
Any state fact lacks task, receipt, or tool-event provenance.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells.

records.falsifier: Any unused future-generation projection is measured, any generation-zero request includes state, no post-recycle request receives state, source/effect integrity changes, or the frozen paired native target is not met.
records.mechanism: Await rendering at the recycler boundary. Build and tokenizer-measure state only after the recycler chooses the actual generation, expose nothing at generation zero, and bind the exact measured projection into the successful request.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; exact-generation post-recycle state with structured terminal submission common.
records.statement: An event-derived task-state projection constructed only at the recycler-selected generation improves useful completion without speculative measurement.

experiment_template.research_question: Does recovery deduplication reduce model tokens without useful-outcome loss?

records.falsifier: Deduplication does not reduce model tokens or reduces native quality/completion.
records.mechanism: Retain confirmed handles after recycling and suppress already recovered exact ranges within an epoch.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; exact-generation post-recycle state with structured terminal submission common.
records.statement: Phase-bound deduplication of source recovery, rather than task-state projection, is sufficient to reduce token use without quality loss.

experiment_template.research_question: Does exact-generation state produce no native improvement?

records.falsifier: A state-only treatment improves frozen paired native outcomes under identical caps and tools.
records.mechanism: The model can recover observable evidence; remaining errors are interpretation and selection failures.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; exact-generation post-recycle state with structured terminal submission common.
records.statement: Exact-generation state exposure does not improve native outcomes because semantic task reasoning is the limiting factor.

selection.reason: H11 remains untested because exposure was zero. H13 first removes the observed speculative-measurement defect at the exact recycler boundary; H12 and the semantic null remain competing explanations.
